messages:
Maya: Hi @alex — thanks for the report about the 402 on /v1/chat. To escalate to eng we need a tiny repro pack. Please attach or paste the items below so we can reproduce and link logs.
Maya: Short checklist (minimal, actionable):
1) ONE request-ref / trace id from the failing request (exact header or Console request row).
2) A minimal curl that reproduces the error (see example).
3) HAR or screenshot of the Console request detail (do NOT paste API keys).
4) Environment: prod/stage, region, account id (last 6), billing plan, and approximate timestamp (UTC).
5) If mobile/embedded: SDK debug bundle or the SDK debug command you ran.

Maya: Where to find the request-ref in common places:
- Console (web): Console -> Requests -> filter status:402 -> click the row -> top panel shows "Request ref" (copy that value). Screenshot helps if you can't export logs.
- Browser SDK: open DevTools Network, find the request to api.redwood.ai, look at request headers for header named `x-request-ref` or `x-redwood-req`.
- Node / Server-side: search your stdout/structured logs for `x-request-ref` or `request_ref`.
- Mobile SDKs: run the SDK debug command (examples below) to produce a debug bundle that includes the request ref and local logs.

Maya: Minimal curl sample (replace placeholders, redact bearer token before sharing):
```
curl -v "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -H "X-Request-Ref: abc123-EXAMPLE" \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Maya: Browser HAR export quick steps:
1) DevTools -> Network -> preserve log -> reproduce -> right-click -> Save all as HAR.
2) Attach the HAR file. If HAR includes auth header, please open it in a text editor and replace the Authorization value with `<REDACTED>` before uploading.

Maya: Mobile SDK debug bundle examples (one of these will generate an uploadable artifact):
- iOS (Swift):
```
RedwoodDebug.capture(reason: "billing-402") { result in
  // returns uploadable bundle id or file
}
```
- Android (Kotlin):
```
RedwoodDebug.captureBundle("billing-402")
```
- Node/JS SDK (sync):
```
await Redwood.debug.dumpBundle({ reason: 'billing-402' })
```
Maya: Billing-specific items to push with the repro: account id (or last 6), invoice id shown in the Console, time of failure (UTC), and if available the last 4 of the card on file. Do NOT send full card numbers.

Alex: Thanks — one weird bit: our server logs show 402 and nothing in the response body, and Console row is missing a request-ref. Where should I look first?

Maya: If Console row has no request-ref, still try these in order:
- Check the server-side outgoing request headers (your proxy or gateway may strip headers). If you see `x-request-ref` there, copy it.
- If you use a gateway (Cloudflare/ALB/proxy), grab the ingress logs with the upstream request ID.
- Failing that, attach a HAR or screenshot of the Console request panel (we can sometimes infer the missing ref from timing + account id).

Sam: If you can't share raw ids, a screenshot of the Console request detail with the surrounding timestamp + the exact endpoint + account id is usually enough to find the trace on our side. Also share the minimal curl above with a fake token.

Maya: Example minimal repro message we need in the support thread (copy/paste):
```
- account_id: 876543
- timestamp_utc: 2026-03-16T21:42:10Z
- endpoint: POST /v1/chat
- region: us-west-2
- request_ref: abc123-EXAMPLE
- minimal_curl: curl ... (paste with <REDACTED>)
- attachments: my-network.har, console-request-screenshot.png
- billing: invoice_1234, plan: pro-monthly
```
Maya: Please redact any token values. If you need to share logs that contain tokens we prefer: replace the token value with `<TOKEN_REDACTED>` or provide a screenshot instead.

Alex: Got it. I can grab the HAR and a screenshot. One more: how do I generate the server-side header if we didn't log it?

Sam: Quick server fallback: if you control the code that calls Redwood, add a temporary log line to echo headers on the failing request, e.g. in Node/Express middleware:
```
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  console.log('outgoing-redwood-headers', req.headers['x-request-ref'], req.headers['authorization'] ? 'AUTH_PRESENT' : 'NO_AUTH');
  next();
});
```
Then reproduce once and paste the log line (redacting auth).

Alex: Uploading HAR + screenshot now, and I'll run the debug capture on mobile.

dev-bot: Debug bundle received (bundle-id: bundle-20260316-987).

Maya: Awesome, received the HAR + screenshot + debug bundle id. I'll escalate to eng and include Sam. :white_check_mark:

Sam: On eng side we'll link the bundle + HAR to the infra logs using timestamp + account id. If we need a live repro we may ask you for a curl that hits a test account (we can provide a short-lived test token).

Alex: Thanks all, sending the server log line in a sec.
